bounded_contract.completion: A completion counter is consumed only by a non-blocking wait; timeout is not slept or scheduled.
bounded_contract.workqueue: Accepted work invokes its callback synchronously in the submitting isolated driver domain.
bounded_contract.timer: A timer records one pending deadline and supports cancellation; no clock service dispatches its callback.
bounded_contract.spinlock: Lock state is single-driver-domain bookkeeping; it does not mask IRQs, disable preemption or supply SMP mutual exclusion.

not_claimed: Linux scheduler, sleeping waits, worker threads or asynchronous workqueues
timer tick, timekeeping, timer callback dispatch or timeout expiry
SMP-safe locks, IRQ masking, preemption control or lock dependency checking
general Linux driver-model compatibility, native Linux module execution, network stack or NIC delegation
